metadata.title: On unifying Jones representations of braid groups and Thompson's group
metadata.abstract: We unify Jones' representations of braid groups and the oriented Thompson's group by introducing the oriented dyadic braid group. This finitely generated group contains every braid group and the oriented Thompson's group. We construct an embedding of the oriented Thompson's group into this group such that taking braid closures recovers Jones' construction of oriented links. We also introduce the dyadic Temperley-Lieb algebra and construct a unitary representation of the oriented dyadic braid group extending the classical Jones representations of braid groups. Along the Thompson group's embedding, its distinguished matrix coefficient agrees with the corresponding coefficient of Jones' representation of the oriented Thompson's group.
